findings.summary: Accept/Reject floating button bar lost `-translate-x-1/2` centering transform during bulk `tw-` prefix migration
findings.failure_scenario: The fixed-position button bar uses `left-1/2` (line 241) to position at horizontal center, but the `-translate-x-1/2` transform that pulls it back by half its own width was dropped (the old code had `-translate-x-1/2` after `left-1/2`). The bar now renders offset to the right by half its width instead of being centered at the bottom of the ApplyView. Observed on any composer window where Accept/Reject buttons appear.

findings.summary: Diff change block container lost `flex` layout class during prefix migration, breaking inline diff display layout
findings.failure_scenario: The container div for each change line within a diff block (line 310) had `flex relative border-l-3` in the old code. The `tw-` migration dropped `flex` entirely (now only `tw-relative`). Individual change lines (`added`/`removed` spans) were laid out as flex children; they now default to block layout. This affects the visual alignment of the `+`/`-` diff display in the composer ApplyView when reviewing code changes.

findings.summary: ProjectItem hover state lost valid background highlight (`hover:bg-interactive-accent/5`) and border opacity modifier (`/30`) during prefix migration
findings.failure_scenario: The old ProjectItem className (line 49) included `hover:border-interactive-accent/30 hover:bg-interactive-accent/5 hover:shadow-[...]`. The `tw-` migration replaced this with `hover:tw-border-interactive-accent hover:tw-text-accent hover:tw-shadow-[...]`. Two valid effects were lost: (1) `hover:bg-interactive-accent/5` (a subtle 5% accent background highlight) was completely dropped; (2) `hover:border-interactive-accent/30` lost its `/30` opacity modifier, changing the hover border from 30% to 100% opacity accent color. A new `hover:tw-text-accent` effect was added instead. This changes the visual hover feedback on project cards.
